Hi Juliana,

you could use the cutw function in the tuneR package to select and cut a section of a *.wav file

library(tuneR)

file<-readWave("yourworkingdirectory\\recit.mp3") 
sample1<-cutw(file, from=0, to=120, output="Wave")
sample2<-cutw(file, from=120, to=240, output="Wave")
sample3<-....
sample4<-....

I am pretty sure you can use a loop to split your file automatically with one command

An different/easier way to do it could be to use Audacity through the "Regular Interval Labels..." and the "Export Multiple..." commands.  
http://manual.audacityteam.org/o/man/regular_interval_labels.html
http://manual.audacityteam.org/o/man/export_multiple.html

Regards,

Nino
